title: Prove exact connector price with correlated source updates
body:
## Result

A scoped all-length exact query theorem for a persistent dirty connector when imposed source updates have a **known binary dependence matrix**. This changes the independence hypothesis of Ross Richardson's merged PR1780; sequential no-prewrite/no-late-write output deliveries, arbitrary dirty inputs, and every mandatory source update are retained.

For update prefixes s_i and query/correction parities q_i,t_j, the exact complete-query bill is

```
2 sum a_i + min [sum b_i(2-q_i) + sum d_j t_j]
```

subject to `XOR q_i=0` and `XOR(q_i*s_i) XOR XOR(t_j*v_j)=0`. The proof covers arbitrary query multiplicities, not just paired-readout candidates. Two reads around a source query attain every feasible parity choice without requiring intermediate connector coherence. Independent updates recover PR1780's formula.

The source-bound PR1439/PR1780 four-request pilot reuses one update row. It needs **59 scalar XORs**, versus **63** for the strengthened best coherent schedule and **87** separately closed. All mutations, readouts and source calls are paid. Actual return-to-origin head steps are 1128/1176/1472; the declared unit local-backend totals are 1423/1491/1907. The correlated word attains the componentwise query minimum of 4B+8A+0D.

**Limits:** this is an optimum in the explicitly indivisible call alphabet. Opening the pilot's maps gives a cheaper, checked 31-XOR direct-fusion program. No selected physical caller, recursive rank-profile gain, supplier admission, contracting recurrence, formal-kernel theorem, measured runtime improvement or new kappa is claimed.

## Evidence and reproduction

Only `research/correlated-update-delivery/` is added, with README proof, complete SELECTION/TASK/SOURCES/VERIFY metadata, source-parsed fixture, certificate, primary optimizer, code-disjoint full-alphabet Dijkstra oracle and integrity checks.

```
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python scripts/research_package.py --package research/correlated-update-delivery
```

Observed on CPython3.12.12, Darwin arm64:

```
PASS_CORRELATED_UPDATE_DELIVERY instances=300 pilot=59/63/87 direct_fusion=31 maps=4096 controls=11 no_new_kappa
PASS_CORRELATED_UPDATE_PACKAGE controls=5 optimized_relocated_read_only
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/correlated-update-delivery outcome=completed
```

The 300 cases exhaust d=1,2, k<=4, every update-vector sequence and three tariffs including exact fractions. The independent oracle settles21070states and agrees with an additional exhaustive parity enumeration;72cases beat coherent pricing. Checks include4096arbitrary2x2 map triples, all19dirty basis columns of each literal pilot,384exhaustive scalar dirty executions,16independent-update predecessor specializations and24periodic fixtures. Controls reject dependence drift, missing/late/early operations, omitted restoration, false invoices, source/receipt corruption and occupied-output overwrites. Optimized relocated replay and canonical regenerated evidence pass. No hosted-CI result is claimed.

Exact live heads were rechecked and all three numbered predecessors are merged. Shared cached coverage was329openPRs includingdrafts and692discussions/comments/replies, with complete pagination at18:11–18:12UTC; targeted final queries and Discussion1776 found no overlapping successor, without treating no-match as novelty proof.
